summary: Implement the backoff spec: raise the retry ceiling to 5 attempts with doubling delay, and add a guard so the same job id can never be claimed twice at once.

steps.step: Change MAX_ATTEMPTS to 5 and add a doubling delay between retries.
steps.acceptance: Retries work correctly and jobs eventually land in dead-letter.

steps.step: Add a lock in claim() so two workers can never claim the same job id at the same time.

contracts.rule: A failed job should get up to 5 attempts before landing in dead-letter, with delay doubling between attempts
